title: full-set triage: why the bench host is red where CI is green

findings.claim: the update path read every store's schema version through query_to_xml and xpath, which a PostgreSQL built without libxml refuses (unsupported XML feature), so installed_state stopped on such a server; fixed: two reads with no XML, the statements quoted by the server
the rehearsal's row count before and after a failing restore used the same query_to_xml and xpath way; fixed: psql's gexec runs each table's count statement made by the server
lane H's backup and restore tests ran the bare psql and pg_dump from PATH, red on a host whose PostgreSQL is not on PATH; fixed: the tests hand in the test cluster's own client tools

lane H's fixtures built box trees under the run's umask, so at umask 0002 the product rightly refused them (deploy/.env, deploy/site, a passphrase folder writable by the group); fixed: the built trees as root makes them (H-115's helper)
lane D's backup tests run the bare psql and pg_dump from PATH (58 reds on the bench host), and backup.py meets a missing client tool with a bare FileNotFoundError instead of naming it
findings.place: tests/unit/test_backup.py, test_backup_restic.py, test_backup_busy_night.py, test_restore_drill.py; tools/trialbox/backup.py take_snapshot

findings.claim: the console's Node Playwright check runs at import inside a skipif, so a node slower than 60 s makes every importing module a collection error, once per xdist worker (112 on the bench host)
test_erasure_reach errors at setup on the bench host (226), read by the walk as unsupported XML feature; not reproduced: the module passes here and its fixture sends no XML statement
